faq.q: How many hours a day do French Bulldogs sleep?
faq.a: There are no breed-specific studies, but adult dogs in general sleep roughly 10 to 13 hours a day, counting night sleep and naps. A healthy adult Frenchie in that range is normal.

faq.q: How much do French Bulldog puppies sleep?
faq.a: In a large UK study, 16-week-old puppies slept about 11 hours a day: around 7 hours at night plus 3.5 hours of naps. We found no reliable source for the often-repeated 18 to 20 hours.

faq.q: Why does my French Bulldog sleep all day?
faq.a: It can be normal for a laid-back companion breed, especially when bored or hot. But if your dog also snores, tires quickly or struggles in the heat, poor breathing at night may be leaving them sleepy during the day, so talk to your vet.

faq.q: Is it normal for French Bulldogs to snore?
faq.a: It is common but not normal. Cambridge researchers say snoring and snorting signal an obstructed airway. Film your dog sleeping and show your vet.

faq.q: Why does my French Bulldog sleep with his eyes open?
faq.a: Frenchies have large, prominent eyes that the lids may not fully cover during sleep. Usually it is harmless, but see your vet if the eyes look red, have discharge or your dog squints.
